name: 3d-avatar-assistant
description: Realistic, lip-synced 3D virtual-assistant avatar (Three.js + open-source Kokoro TTS).

scripts.setup: node tools/fetch-assets.mjs && npm run build-avatar && node tools/fetch-voices.mjs
scripts.build-avatar: blender -b --factory-startup -noaudio --python tools/blender/build_avatar.py -- --src assets-src/rocketbox --out assets-src/avatar.raw.glb && gltfpack -i assets-src/avatar.raw.glb -o public/avatar/avatar.glb -cc -kn -km -ke -vp 16 -vn 10 -af 30 && cp assets-src/rocketbox/LICENSE.md public/avatar/LICENSE-rocketbox.md
